roles._cycles: CYCLE-1, CYCLE-2,4, CYCLE-3 repeat at 4x slab spacing (@600 for @150 drawings, @500 for @125). CYCLE-3 = CYCLE-1 with the OUTER (exterior-face) bars mirrored left-right; inner-face bars (T4-T6, B1-B3, W1/W2, O1/O2) stay in place. Marks below are for H3-1..H3-30 (B<=3.5 m); see _B4000 for H3-31..35.
roles.T1: top slab outer (top-face) bar, left end piece: runs over left cell and is bent down the outer face of the left side wall (long leg, laps B4); CYCLE-1 (mirrored to right end in CYCLE-3)
roles.T2: top slab outer-face middle piece, single straight bar spanning the middle cell and both middle walls, lapped (390/490 mm) with T1 and T3; CYCLE-1/3
roles.T3: top slab outer-face right end piece, bent down outer face of right side wall (short leg, laps B6); CYCLE-1/3
roles.T4: top slab inner (bottom-face) bar of left cell, anchored into side wall / past middle wall 1; CYCLE-1/3
roles.T5: top slab inner (bottom-face) bar of middle cell, extends into both middle walls; CYCLE-1/3
roles.T6: top slab inner (bottom-face) bar of right cell; CYCLE-1/3
roles.T7: top slab outer-face left corner piece bent down left side-wall outer face (laps B10); CYCLE-2,4
roles.T8: top slab outer-face piece over left/middle cell, lapped over middle wall 1 (400 lap); CYCLE-2,4
roles.T9: top slab outer-face piece over middle/right cell, lapped over middle wall 2; CYCLE-2,4
roles.T10: top slab outer-face right corner piece bent down right side-wall outer face (laps B13); CYCLE-2,4
roles.T11: top slab inner (bottom-face) bar, left cell; CYCLE-2,4
roles.T12: top slab inner (bottom-face) bar, middle cell; CYCLE-2,4
roles.T13: top slab inner (bottom-face) bar, right cell; CYCLE-2,4
roles.B1: bottom slab inner (top-face) bar, left cell; CYCLE-1/3
roles.B2: bottom slab inner (top-face) bar, middle cell; CYCLE-1/3
roles.B3: bottom slab inner (top-face) bar, right cell; CYCLE-1/3
roles.B4: bottom slab outer (bottom-face) left end piece bent up left side-wall outer face (short leg, laps T1); CYCLE-1 (mirrored in CYCLE-3)
roles.B5: bottom slab outer-face middle piece spanning middle cell and both middle walls, lapped with B4/B6; CYCLE-1/3
roles.B6: bottom slab outer-face right end piece bent up right side-wall outer face (long leg, laps T3); CYCLE-1/3
roles.B7: bottom slab inner (top-face) bar, left cell; CYCLE-2,4
roles.B8: bottom slab inner (top-face) bar, middle cell; CYCLE-2,4
roles.B9: bottom slab inner (top-face) bar, right cell; CYCLE-2,4
roles.B10: bottom slab outer-face left corner piece bent up left side-wall outer face (laps T7); CYCLE-2,4
roles.B11: bottom slab outer-face piece, lapped over middle wall 1; CYCLE-2,4
roles.B12: bottom slab outer-face piece, lapped over middle wall 2; CYCLE-2,4
roles.B13: bottom slab outer-face right corner piece bent up right side-wall outer face (laps T10); CYCLE-2,4
roles.W1: left side wall inner-face vertical bar (side wall inner face @2x spacing, i.e. only in CYCLE-1/3)
roles.W2: right side wall inner-face vertical bar (CYCLE-1/3)
roles.O1: middle wall 1 vertical bars, one on each face, running full height into top/bottom slabs (CYCLE-1/3; count = 2 faces x cycles 1,3)
roles.O2: middle wall 2 vertical bars, both faces (CYCLE-1/3)
roles.H1: haunch bar (straight a with 135-deg legs b=100) across the top haunches at the side walls (2 outer top corners)
roles.H2: haunch bars across the top haunches at the middle walls (4 corners -> double count)
roles.H3: diagonal corner bar at the bottom inner corners at the side walls (bottom corners have no haunch; 135-deg legs)
roles.H4: diagonal corner bars at the bottom inner corners at the middle walls (4 corners)
roles.D1: longitudinal distribution bars, top slab (both faces), 1.05-1.08 m per 1 m incl. lap
roles.D2: longitudinal distribution bars, bottom slab (both faces)
roles.D3: longitudinal distribution bars, side walls (both faces, both walls)
roles.D4: longitudinal distribution bars, middle walls (both faces, both walls)
roles.S1: shear tie / cross-tie (hooked) through top slab
roles.S4: tie through middle walls (a/b/c shaped, longer L because it wraps both face bars of the middle wall)
roles.R1: supplementary outer-corner bar (same 135-deg template as H bars, legs b=300) at a side-wall/slab outer corner where the CYCLE-1/3 outer bars lap; first appears H3-6 (only R1), drawn at top-left outer corner in CYCLE-1 (mirrored in CYCLE-3)
roles.R2: second supplementary outer-corner bar (legs b=300) at the bottom-right outer corner / lower right side wall in CYCLE-1 (mirrored in CYCLE-3); appears from H3-17 onward (not in H3-23)
